annotations.title: Review a change before the PR

description: Self-review a change you are about to commit BEFORE opening the PR. Pass the proposed new state of each changed file (and any deleted paths); Moxie Docs returns a severity-ranked list of violations to fix: convention breaches, docs your change makes factually false, net-new API/surface added without docs, and doc references broken by deletions. Read-only; no side effects and no writes. Returns a Markdown verdict (clean | warnings | must-fix) with each finding's location, fix, and - for doc issues - the slug to pass to propose_doc_update. Call this as the final step of the edit flow, then fix findings and re-run.

changedFiles.description: The files your change adds or modifies, in their PROPOSED new state. Provide newContent (the full new file text) for each; you may also/instead provide patch (a unified diff). Max 20 files per call.

newContent.description: The full new contents of the file after your change.

patch.description: Optional unified diff for the file (used if newContent is omitted).

deletedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths your change DELETES, so Moxie Docs can flag docs whose references break.

repository.description: The target repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "acme/app"). Always pass this unless your token is scoped to a single repository. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted when the token serves multiple repos, the call returns the list of repositories to choose from instead of an answer.

name: moxie.review_change
